sop.title: Statement of purpose details
sop.subtitle: No need to write everything in full. Key points and hints are enough; your writer makes it personal.

tips.0: Some details, like your papers and skills, stay close to what you write; others we drop or add to make the text more personal.
tips.1: We don't write about your country or returning to Iran; that's for the embassy, not the university.
tips.2: The statement is written for your first-choice programme. Very different programmes need separate statements.
tips.3: We'll call you to coordinate after you submit.

help.university_2: Leave empty if you haven't done a master's.
help.university_for_apply: Leave empty if you haven't decided yet.
help.general_sop: A general statement works for several universities; a specific one is tailored to your target university.
help.reason: Tell us how you got interested in it. Childhood and school matter little, but they give us ideas.
help.interest: Your favourite courses and good grades. Which skills make you a good fit for this field?
help.reason_to_continuation: For example: “I want to research clean energy”. Say why this goal matters to you.
help.university_reason: If you have a professor in mind, add their page and say what your work shares. Leave empty if you're applying to several universities.
help.project: Which courses and projects went well during your studies? Add your good grades.
help.internship: What exactly was your role, and what did it add to your knowledge and skills?
help.essay: What was your role in each? Leave empty if you have none.
help.thesis: Add its English title or abstract. Leave empty if you have none.
help.job: What job do you see yourself doing in this field?

cv.title: CV details
cv.subtitle: Write specialist details (thesis title, course names, …) in English. Answers save automatically, so nothing is lost if your connection drops.
cv.noOrder: A CV isn't part of your contract.
cv.finalNote: To submit, add a passport photo and fill in the required sections. After submitting you can't edit.

tips.0: European and North American CVs look different. For Europe, a front-facing photo without glasses is needed.
tips.1: If your CV is thin, we'll ask for more details (with your permission) to make it richer.
tips.2: One round of edits, within a week of delivery. Write the changes in the writing ticket.
tips.3: It takes 7 working days. Your CV is written in LaTeX; you get the PDF and an editing link.
